# My Munch Bug

> Pediatric feeding expert Melanie Potock's comprehensive resource for ARFID, picky eaters, and special needs feeding guidance through courses, coaching, and evidence-based strategies.

My Munch Bug is led by Melanie Potock, MA CCC-SLP, a feeding coach and ARFID specialist who provides professional training, on-demand courses, live events, and one-on-one coaching for parents and professionals. The site emphasizes responsive feeding, sensory processing, and practical strategies for children with feeding challenges.

## Key Topics

- ARFID (Avoidant/Restrictive Food Intake Disorder)
- Picky eaters
- Pediatric feeding therapy
- Responsive feeding
- Special needs feeding
- Melanie Potock
- Sensory processing and eating
- Baby-led feeding
- Feeding anxiety
- Child nutrition
- ASHA CEUs
- Tube feeding
- Appetite regulation
- Toddler nutrition
- Seven senses eating framework

## Core Services & Programs

- [Melanie Potock – Pediatric Feeding Expert and Author](https://mymunchbug.com): Homepage for Melanie Potock's pediatric feeding expertise and services
- [Coaching for Parents & Professionals](https://mymunchbug.com/coaching): One-on-one coaching services for picky eaters and feeding guidance
- [Course Library](https://mymunchbug.com/course-library): On-demand courses on ARFID, picky eaters, and feeding development
- [Feeding Masterclasses](https://mymunchbug.com/feeding-masterclass): Online masterclasses on ARFID, tube feeding, and appetite regulation
- [Melanie Potock Live Events](https://mymunchbug.com/melanie-potock-live-events): In-person and live training events with ASHA CEUs and professional development

## About & Credentials

## Educational Resources

- [What is ARFID?](https://mymunchbug.com/what-is-arfid): Educational guide explaining ARFID and anxiety-based eating disorders
- [Expert Feeding Advice for Parents & Professionals](https://mymunchbug.com/picky-eater-advice-for-professionals-and-parents): Expert feeding advice on ARFID, sensory eating, and special needs
- [Free Toolbox](https://mymunchbug.com/free-toolbox): Free feeding guides and resources on responsive feeding and nutrition
- [A Special Needs Guide for Learning to Eat with Your SEVEN Senses – Part One](https://mymunchbug.com/2021/01/a-special-needs-guide-for-learning-to-eat-with-your-seven-senses-part-one): Guide on sensory processing and seven senses in special needs feeding

## Blog & Practical Tips

- [50 Easy Ways to Get Your Kid to Eat New Foods](https://mymunchbug.com/2021/02/50-easy-ways-to-get-your-kid-to-eat-new-foods): Practical tips for introducing new foods to picky eaters
- [3 Ways to Explain Baby-Led Feeding to Your Extended Family](https://mymunchbug.com/2020/12/3-ways-to-explain-baby-led-feeding-to-your-extended-family): Advice on communicating baby-led feeding approaches to family
- [Planting for Kids](https://mymunchbug.com/2020/10/planting-for-kids): Tips on using gardening to engage picky eaters with fresh food
